corrigendum_2026_06_10_gap4.contamination_sharpened: 30/31 pool tasks appear VERBATIM in the public ARC-AGI-2 TRAINING set (stronger than the 'ARC-1 eval is public' wording); the single non-overlap task (79fb03f4) is among codex's 3 failures; failures do not concentrate on hard tasks. The 29/31 induction rate has near-zero transfer value to uncontaminated tasks. Also: codex ran with --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox on a host where the eval solutions file is readable, and transcripts were not archived — the no-oracle invariant is verified at prompt+code level only (mitigants: 5/31 failures, visible iterative refinement, zero hardcoded grids, no task id in the prompt).
corrigendum_2026_06_10_gap4.exact_significance: Exact paired sign test: gated-vs-vote one-sided p=0.0625 (4W/0L/27T; two-sided 0.125); gated-vs-union p=0.125 (3W/0L). NOT significant at 0.05 at n=31. The bootstrap CI lower bound >0 is a percentile-discreteness artifact; gates.selection_beats_union is point-estimate-only. The entry-level bootstrap also treats f3e62deb's two correlated entries as independent; use a unique-task cluster bootstrap at 400 scale.
corrigendum_2026_06_10_gap4.file_hygiene: The histories array double-lists f3e62deb's single induction (45 records vs 44 calls; artifact accounting already correct).
corrigendum_2026_06_10_gap4.forward_protocol: 400-task re-confirmation MUST: run codex filesystem/network-jailed on a host without ARC solutions on disk; archive full transcripts; include genuinely held-out tasks (ARC-AGI-2 eval / ConceptARC holdout / post-cutoff); add the codex-first arm; cluster bootstrap + exact tests (zero-loss design needs >=6 discordant wins for two-sided p<0.05); harden the exec sandbox (timeout; block np.load/np.save/np.fromfile/type).
corrigendum_2026_06_10_gap4.generator_attribution: THE KEY REFRAME: codex-standalone (trust the demo-perfect program's output directly) scores 0.8387 against true gold — ABOVE the pool oracle ceiling 0.6129; the trivial codex-first arm (program output if demo-perfect else vote) scores 28/31 = 0.903. The rerank venue CLIPS the generator by ~42%. The pass@2 lift is generator-attributable; the gate contributes the zero-pass@2-loss safety wrapper + abstention, not independent selection signal. UNION+exec == GATED exactly (TRM scalar features are dead weight given exec).

Gold-favorable ties: vote@2=0.4839, delta +0.0968, recovered=3 (tie-robust set: 17cae0c1, be03b35f, f3e62deb), gated-vs-vote CI [0.0, 0.1935]. Expected-value ties: delta ~+0.113. GAP4_GATED itself is tie-invariant at 0.5806.
corrigendum_2026_06_10_gap4.true_gold_scoring: pred_is_gold in per_task means gold-AND-IN-POOL (15/29) and understates program correctness: against the official Kaggle gold the demo-perfect programs are correct on 26/29 (26/31 overall = 0.8387), including 11/12 entries where gold is absent from TRM's pool (the gate correctly abstains but discards genuinely-correct answers).

decentralization_note: Closed-weight generator (gpt-5.5) used as the escalation-tier inducer per the M2-v3 precedent; deployment tier targets a local open-weight inducer (Gemma-4/Qwen3.6 GGUF). The verifier side (demo-fit + execution + rerank) is fully local and model-free.

generator.data_handling_class: minimize (public ARC demo grids + test input only)

model_specs.verifier: model-free: demo-fit exact-reproduction gate + restricted-namespace execution + content-hash candidate match

no_oracle_audit: The codex prompt contains demo pairs + the test INPUT only — never the test gold and never the candidate pool. Programs are verified on demos (public context); the gated ranker overrides vote ONLY on demo_fit==1.0 AND exact candidate match of the executed output; otherwise it IS vote. 'correct' labels score rankings post-hoc.
reproducibility_note: Codex generation is stochastic, but the induced programs are SAVED verbatim in results/arc3_gap4_induced_programs.json (sha256 prefix above): the entire rerank re-derives deterministically from the saved programs + the eval pool with zero API calls.
surprising_result_acknowledgment: First positive of the GAP-3/GAP-4 program (+0.129 pass@2 over vote, bootstrap CI [0.0323, 0.2581] above zero at n=31). PRELIMINARY until: (a) the adversarial round confirms (in flight), and (b) re-confirmation at 400-task scale per the standing GAP-3 caveat. KNOWN CONFOUND, disclosed up-front: ARC-AGI-1 evaluation tasks are PUBLIC and plausibly in gpt-5.5's training data — the 29/31 demo-perfect induction rate may overstate induction on truly held-out tasks (benchmark contamination). The no-oracle invariant holds at the PROMPT level (demos + test input only); it cannot hold at the WEIGHTS level for a public benchmark. The mechanical claims (gate safety: 0 vote-wins lost; exact-match promotion; demo-fit verification) are contamination-independent; the INDUCTION RATE is not.
